newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes signs $100 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes signs $100 mln credit facility.

text.p: Finnish cranemaker KCI Konecranes International said in a statement on Wednesday it had signed a $100 million multi-currency revolving credit facility with an international banking syndicate.
"The credit facility is valid for five years and the annual interest rate margin is 0.225 percent (over Libor) in the first three years and 0.275 after that," it said.
The facility replaced earlier arrangements and it would be used for future needs and short-term working capital financing, it said.
"At the moment, we do not have a borrowing need since our cash position is bigger than our old credits," it said, adding that the timing was now good for the arrangement.
The lead managers were Enskilda and Merita and Postipankki was co-manager, it said.
Other institutions in the syndicate were Banque Indosuez Helsinki, Citibank N.A., Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Suomen Vientiluotto, Royal Bank of Canada Group and Unibank. @
